tree.heading: Affected source
tree.text: The term “affected source” shall have the meaning given such term in subchapter IV–A.

tree.heading: Major source
tree.text: The term “major source” means any stationary source (or any group of stationary sources located within a contiguous area and under common control) that is either of the following:

children.text: A major source as defined in section 7412 of this title.
A major stationary source as defined in section 7602 of this title or part D of subchapter I.

tree.heading: Schedule of compliance
tree.text: The term “schedule of compliance” means a schedule of remedial measures, including an enforceable sequence of actions or operations, leading to compliance with an applicable implementation plan, emission standard, emission limitation, or emission prohibition.

tree.heading: Permitting authority
tree.text: The term “permitting authority” means the Administrator or the air pollution control agency authorized by the Administrator to carry out a permit program under this subchapter.
